item.title: Manchester United Overcomes Two-Goal Deficit to Clinch Thrilling 3-2 Champions League Victory
item.description: Manchester United completed a dramatic second-half comeback to defeat Roma 3-2 at Old Trafford in the Champions League.

item.title: Manchester City looks to snap three-match winless streak against perfect RB Leipzig
item.description: Manchester City travels to face RB Leipzig, who remains unbeaten at home this season without conceding a single goal.

item.title: Undefeated Real Betis storms Signal Iduna Park to challenge Borussia Dortmund
item.description: Borussia Dortmund hosts an undefeated Real Betis side on Wednesday evening for a crucial UEFA Champions League group stage encounter.

item.title: Arsenal storms into Prague for Champions League clash against Slavia Prague
item.description: Arsenal plays an away Champions League fixture against Slavia Prague today with the English side expected to win.

item.title: Eagles Promote Joe Milton to Starting Quarterback Role Against New York Giants
item.description: Joe Milton takes over as the Philadelphia Eagles' starting quarterback for this Sunday's game against the New York Giants.

item.title: Real Madrid Storms Greece Seeking Seventh Straight Win Against Struggling AEK Athens
item.description: Real Madrid faces AEK Athens at the ALLWYN Arena this Wednesday, aiming to maintain their flawless Champions League record.

item.title: Andoni Iraola hands five changes to Liverpool line-up for Fenerbahce clash
item.description: Liverpool faces Fenerbahce in Istanbul tonight for a UEFA Champions League league-phase fixture.

item.title: Kellogg’s Admits Rice Krispies Snap, Crackle and Pop is Quieter After Reformulation
item.description: Kellogg's replaced whole rice grains with corn and rice flour in UK Rice Krispies and Coco Pops, resulting in a noticeably quieter sound.

item.title: Dublin institution Bunsen Burger claims second spot in global burger rankings
item.description: Travel blog Big 7 ranked Dublin-based Bunsen Burger as the second-best burger joint in the world.

item.title: Real Madrid reach verbal agreement to snatch Manchester United teenager JJ Gabriel
item.description: Real Madrid expects to sign 16-year-old forward JJ Gabriel in January after the player walked out on Manchester United in September.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Braces for Heavy Rain as Depression Approaches Bay of Bengal
item.description: The India Meteorological Department expects three days of moderate rain across south coastal Andhra Pradesh as a weather system develops over the Bay of Bengal.

item.title: Power outage at London studio forces ITV to pull live morning shows
item.description: ITV cancelled live broadcasts of Lorraine, This Morning, and Loose Women on Wednesday, November 4, following an overnight power cut at the Covent Garden studio.

item.title: Mid-Michigan voters head to polls for crucial statewide races and local proposals
item.description: Voters in mid-Michigan cast their ballots on Tuesday, Nov. 3, to decide on various statewide races and local bond and millage proposals.

item.title: Virat Kohli Smashes Cricket History With 13,000 ODI Runs at No. 3
item.description: Virat Kohli became the first batter to reach 13,000 ODI runs at the number three position during the opening match of India's tour of New Zealand.

item.title: Academy Graduate Senny Mayulu Starts As PSG Storms Villarreal For Champions League
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain faces Villarreal this Tuesday for matchday four of the Champions League league phase.

item.title: Stuttgart backtracks after mocking Galatasaray’s stadium sound system before Champions League clash
item.description: VfB Stuttgart apologized to Galatasaray after a deleted social media post questioning the authenticity of the atmosphere at Rams-Park.

item.title: Ravens sign Kedon Slovis to bolster quarterback room after multiple injury hits
item.description: The Baltimore Ravens are signing 25-year-old quarterback Kedon Slovis from the Green Bay Packers practice squad to address a depleted roster.

item.title: Democrats Target Eight Key Senate Seats to Topple Current Republican Majority
item.description: Control of the U.S. Senate rests on 35 seats contested in the 2026 midterms, with eight races remaining uncalled by experts.

item.title: Americans head to polls in referendum on Trump's second term agenda
item.description: Voters across the United States are casting ballots today to determine which party controls Congress for the remainder of Donald Trump's presidency.

item.title: Ginebra eyes series sweep to topple San Miguel in PBA quarterfinals showdown
item.description: Barangay Ginebra attempts to eliminate San Miguel Beer in tonight’s Game 3 of their PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup quarterfinals.

item.title: Hackers crank European supermarket fridges to 50C in mass food supply attack
item.description: Hackers targeted supermarket refrigeration units across seven European countries and the UK on Monday by remotely increasing temperatures, causing potential food spoilage.

item.title: Mystery NSW Player Snatches Entire $60 Million Oz Lotto Jackpot in Blacktown
item.description: A single ticket sold in Blacktown, New South Wales, matched all winning numbers in Tuesday night's Oz Lotto draw 1707.

item.title: Alexandra Eala surges to career-high world number 17 in WTA rankings
item.description: Filipina tennis star Alexandra Eala achieved a new career-best ranking of 17th globally following a quarterfinal run at the 2026 Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo.

item.title: Scott Parker Nears West Ham Manager Role After Nuno Espirito Santo Sacking
item.description: West Ham United have dismissed Nuno Espirito Santo after 13 Championship games, with former player Scott Parker in advanced talks to take over.

item.title: Met Eireann issues Status Yellow fog warning for eight Irish counties tonight
item.description: Met Eireann has issued a Status Yellow fog warning for eight counties, covering the period from 10pm Monday until 10am Tuesday.

item.title: HMD Unveils Nokia 2360 Flip Featuring Dedicated SOS Button and Remote Control
item.description: HMD has launched the Nokia 2360 Flip in the Philippines for PHP 2,790, offering 2G connectivity and specialized tools for students and seniors.

item.title: Dangerous storms threaten Queensland and New South Wales with giant hail tornadoes
item.description: Severe thunderstorms carrying the risk of tornadoes and hail larger than golf balls are targeting parts of Queensland and northern New South Wales today.

item.title: Ciaron Maher trainer routs Melbourne Cup as Point of Law wins easily
item.description: Point of Law, formerly owned by King Charles III, won the 3200m Melbourne Cup under jockey Ethan Brown at Flemington.

item.title: Point Of Law clinches Melbourne Cup as million dollar bet misfires spectacularly
item.description: Point Of Law secured victory in the 2026 Lexus Melbourne Cup at Flemington as the race favourite Hopewell Rock finished outside the top four.

item.title: Extreme Heat Index Triggers Class Suspensions Across Multiple Philippines Regions for Tuesday
item.description: Classes are suspended in Mulanay, Himamaylan, and Hinigaran on November 3, 2026, as the country grapples with dangerous heat index levels.

item.title: Apple Targets $113 Billion Revenue Milestone as New CEO Takes Command
item.description: Apple reports its fiscal fourth-quarter earnings today, with expectations of $113.46 billion in revenue and earnings per share of $2.

item.title: Ferrari boss slams Hamilton and Leclerc after Mexico City Grand Prix collapse
item.description: Team Principal Fred Vasseur voiced frustration after Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc collided on the opening lap, costing Ferrari a likely victory.

item.title: Palantir Routs Earnings Estimates as US Commercial Revenue Surpasses Government Sales
item.description: Palantir reported Q3 revenue of $2.313 billion and raised its full-year guidance after commercial sales topped government contracts for the first time.

item.title: Everton Silences St James' Park With Narrow 1-0 Win Over Newcastle
item.description: Thierno Barry scored the lone goal to secure an away victory for Everton against Newcastle United in the Premier League.

item.title: S&P 500 Climbs As Oil Prices Plunge Helping Markets Recover From Sell-off
item.description: The S&P 500 rose Monday as U.S. stocks rebounded from a bruising sell-off following a sharp 7.5 per cent drop in oil prices.

item.title: Arsenal break 14-year Anfield drought to storm three points clear at top
item.description: Kai Havertz scored the lone goal as Arsenal secured a 1-0 Premier League victory over Liverpool at Anfield.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo dropped as Al-Nassr reshuffles squad for Pakhtakor AFC clash
item.description: Al-Nassr travels to face Pakhtakor in the AFC Champions League Elite this Monday without Cristiano Ronaldo, Kingsley Coman, and Mohamed Simakan.

item.title: Broadcaster Miriam O’Callaghan Investigates Ireland’s Dramatic 30 Per Cent Birth Rate Plunge
item.description: Veteran presenter Miriam O’Callaghan leads a new two-part documentary examining the causes and future impact of Ireland’s sharp population decline.

item.title: Saquon Barkley Declared Active as Eagles Face Commanders on Sunday Night
item.description: Saquon Barkley is officially active to play against the Commanders on Sunday Night Football despite recent hamstring and back injuries.

item.title: Pink Northern Lights surge across Isle of Wight skies in rare display
item.description: The Aurora Borealis lit up the Isle of Wight on October 10 as heightened solar activity brought rare pink displays to southern skies.
